title: lockflight.ci-review/v1
description: The CI review job's result (review-result.json in the lockflight-review artifact), which the report job joins as data into the review check of lockflight.ci-evidence/v1. The review job runs the reviewer's reproductions of the pull request's code, so the report checks this shape before it uses the verdict, and a result about another head is stale.

head.description: The head commit the review read.

why.description: One line for the check, at most 300 characters.
